meta.description: Quantifies alternative splicing as PSI from RNA-seq with rMATS-turbo, SUPPA2, MAJIQ V3, leafcutter, VAST-TOOLS, Shiba and IRFinder-S, with event taxonomy, tool selection, quality thresholds and reconciliation rules.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; planted PSI, formula and cross-tool concordance reproduce

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-method Skill with no clinical conclusions; disease signatures are cited literature

methodological_ground.detail: Effective-length PSI, tool-family reconciliation and sign conventions held; SUPPA2 and rMATS agree in direction

code_usability.detail: Documented code does not run on real output: the inline snippet raises TypeError on every real rMATS JC file and parse_rmats_output raises KeyError for 4 of 5 listed event types (SQ-01, SQ-02); the SE path silently returns wrong mean_PSI (SQ-03)

functional_suitability.note: Broad, accurate taxonomy and tool-selection guidance; the rMATS formula, SUPPA2 and regtools commands reproduce, but the inline snippet, the shipped parser (4 of 5 event types), mean_PSI and the IRFinder command are wrong

reliability.note: Raw KeyError/TypeError on documented use, silent exit 0 with zero clusters on untagged BAMs, run_suppa2_quantification silently skips missing event files

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 290 lines with failure modes and IR/microexon detail routed to references; the tool matrix and decision tree overlap

agent_usability.note: Decision tables, quality thresholds and reconciliation rules are clear; no format contract for rMATS BAM lists or SUPPA2 TPM and no XS prerequisite

human_usability.note: Good pitfalls and prompts; errors are uninformative and unsupported benchmark figures are stated as fact

security.note: No credentials; subprocess calls use argument lists; no shell interpolation

maintainability.note: Small modular script, but SE-only column assumptions, hardcoded 0.1-0.9 filter, no tests, no dependency pins

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger description; progressive disclosure works; Related Skills names do not resolve on the shelf and MAJIQ/VAST are not labeled not-executed

inputs.label: rMATS-turbo on real chrX 2v2 BAMs, then parse PSI per the Skill
inputs.note: rMATS ran with the Skill flags (rc 0, 958 SE events); the inline pandas snippet raised TypeError and the shipped parser reports wrong mean_PSI on 310 of 958 SE rows

assertions.text: rMATS runs with the flags the Skill states and writes all five *.MATS.JC.txt files
assertions.note: rc 0; SE 958, A5SS 216, A3SS 251, MXE 51, RI 174 rows

assertions.text: The SKILL.md inline snippet computes mean PSI from the real JC file
assertions.note: TypeError: IncLevel1/2 are comma strings and startswith(IncLevel) also matches IncLevelDifference (SQ-01)

assertions.text: parse_rmats_output returns the mean of the replicate IncLevel values
assertions.note: mean_PSI includes IncLevelDifference: 310/958 SE rows differ from the true mean, up to 0.5 (e.g. true 0.5 reported 0.0) (SQ-03)

assertions.text: Skill PSI formula reproduces rMATS IncLevel on real data
assertions.note: 1465 replicate values, max abs diff 0.0005 with IncFormLen 148 / SkipFormLen 74

assertions.text: Reliability filter covers both conditions
assertions.note: Both snippet and script filter on SAMPLE_1 only; 47 vs 50 events pass in SAMPLE_2 vs SAMPLE_1 (SQ-03)

inputs.label: rMATS on planted hand-checkable SE data, effective-length PSI
inputs.note: IJC 80,80,80 / SJC 10,10,12 gives IncLevel1 0.8,0.8,0.769 and a 0.587 difference, matching hand values; JC IncFormLen 98 / SkipFormLen 49

assertions.text: rMATS IncLevel equals the hand-computed PSI
Effective-length formula in the Skill gives the planted PSI and differs from naive counts
assertions.note: formula 0.8000, naive 0.8889 (about 11% bias)

assertions.text: IncLevelDifference sign matches --b1 minus --b2
assertions.note: +0.587 with b1 the high group

assertions.text: IncFormLen description matches the JC file
assertions.note: Skill says IncFormLen includes exon body bases; JC value 98 = 2*(50-1), the body appears only in JCEC (149) (SQ-08)

inputs.label: SUPPA2 PSI from TPM via run_suppa2_quantification, planted and real chrX, concordance with rMATS
inputs.note: Planted TPM gives PSI 0.8/0.2/0.5 exactly; real chrX yields all seven psi files; SE r=0.864, A5 r=0.718, A3 r=0.849 vs rMATS; undocumented TPM header and statsmodels limits reproduced

assertions.text: SUPPA2 PSI equals the planted PSI
SS yields A5+A3 and FL yields AF+AL files as the script states
assertions.note: seven psi files from five -e codes

assertions.text: Independent tools agree on direction and magnitude for matched events
assertions.note: SE 892 matched events r=0.864; A5SS 161 r=0.718; A3SS 197 r=0.849, positive, so the A5/A3 sign claim holds

assertions.text: Skill states the TPM header contract and a SUPPA2 dependency pin that works
assertions.note: pandas-default header gives "No expression values have been buffered" and no output; suppa.py fails ImportError (multipletests) with statsmodels 0.15.0 (SQ-06)

assertions.text: filter_reliable_events matches the documented dynamic range
assertions.note: hardcodes mean PSI 0.1-0.9; Skill states 0.05-0.95 (SQ-07)

inputs.label: Shipped parser on the other four rMATS event types
inputs.note: parse_rmats_output raises KeyError for A5SS, A3SS, MXE and RI; only SE works

assertions.text: parse_rmats_output handles every event_type its docstring lists
assertions.note: KeyError ['exonStart_0base', 'exonEnd'] not in index for A5SS, A3SS, MXE, RI (SQ-02)

assertions.text: Failure is reported with an actionable message
assertions.note: raw pandas KeyError after printing event counts

assertions.text: SE path returns reliable events
assertions.note: 50 reliable of 958 at >=20 reads on tiny chrX data

inputs.label: regtools junctions + leafcutter clustering on STAR-style BAMs, with and without XS tags
inputs.note: BAMs without XS give strand ? for every junction and leafcutter exits 0 with 0 clusters; XS-tagged BAMs give 115 clusters at -m 5; the Skill never mentions XS or --outSAMstrandField

assertions.text: regtools extract with the Skill flags succeeds on the aligned BAMs
assertions.note: rc 0 for all four BAMs

assertions.text: Junction strand is resolved for the Skill route (STAR 2-pass BAM, -s XS)
assertions.note: noXS: 2,838 of 2,838 junctions strand ?; XS: 1,398 + / 1,343 - / 99 ? (SQ-04)

assertions.text: leafcutter clustering yields clusters for the stated route
assertions.note: 0 clusters from untagged BAMs at -m 5 (rc 0, silent); 115 from tagged BAMs

assertions.text: Skill warns about XS-tag prerequisite
assertions.note: no mention; STAR default outSAMstrandField None confirmed

assertions.text: Skill -m 50 default is workable on realistic data
assertions.note: tiny test data give 0 clusters at -m 50; not a Skill defect

inputs.label: IRFinder intron retention route from references/
inputs.note: The literal reference command fails (rc 1, "-r is required"); the real syntax IRFinder -m FastQ works on single-end FASTQ (7,955 intron rows); IRFinder-S 2.0 is not what installs

assertions.text: Literal reference command IRFinder FastQ -r REF/ -d out sample.fastq runs
assertions.note: Argument error: -r is required, rc 1; FastQ is a -m value (SQ-05)

assertions.text: Corrected command IRFinder -m FastQ -r REF -d out reads.fq.gz produces IR ratios
assertions.note: 7,955 rows in IRFinder-IR-nondir.txt in 15 s on chrX reads

assertions.text: Skill gives how to obtain the reference and the claimed IRFinder-S 2.0 tool
assertions.note: no BuildRef step; installable release is IRFinder 1.3.1 (SQ-05)

assertions.text: Scope: IR route stays within quantification
assertions.note: no differential testing claimed

key_strengths: Tool-family taxonomy, selection matrix and reconciliation rules are scientifically sound and useful
rMATS effective-length PSI formula, SUPPA2 PSI and A5/A3 sign claims reproduce on planted and real data (rMATS vs SUPPA2 r 0.72-0.86)
Progressive disclosure keeps detail in references/ and the SUPPA2 wrapper and filter run correctly
No credentials, and subprocess calls use argument lists

recommendations.title: SKILL.md inline rMATS snippet raises TypeError
recommendations.problem: se_jc[inc_cols].mean(axis=1) fails on every real rMATS JC file: IncLevel1/2 are comma-separated strings and startswith(IncLevel) also selects IncLevelDifference.
recommendations.root_cause: The snippet was written for numeric columns.
recommendations.fix: Split IncLevel1 and IncLevel2 on commas, convert to float with NA handling, average per event, and exclude IncLevelDifference; execute against a real JC file. (SQ-01)

recommendations.title: parse_rmats_output fails for A5SS/A3SS/MXE/RI
recommendations.problem: The function selects exonStart_0base and exonEnd, which exist only in SE files; A5SS, A3SS, MXE and RI raise KeyError although its docstring lists them.
recommendations.root_cause: Column names are hardcoded for SE.
recommendations.fix: Select coordinate columns per event type (longExon*/shortE*/flanking*, 1stExon*/2ndExon*, riExon*) or return only common columns; test all five types. (SQ-02)

recommendations.title: Shipped mean_PSI is silently wrong; filter ignores group 2
recommendations.problem: The script averages IncLevelDifference with replicate PSI values (310 of 958 SE rows differ, up to 0.5; e.g. true 0.5 reported 0.0), and both snippet and script apply read-count reliability to SAMPLE_1 only.
recommendations.root_cause: Prefix match on IncLevel and SAMPLE_1-only filtering.
recommendations.fix: Restrict to IncLevel1 and IncLevel2, report group-wise means, and apply the junction-read filter to both groups; add a regression on the planted data. (SQ-03)

recommendations.title: regtools/leafcutter route silently empty without XS tags
recommendations.problem: Without XS tags every junction gets strand ? and leafcutter exits 0 with zero clusters (115 clusters from XS-tagged BAMs); the Skill never states the XS prerequisite or STAR --outSAMstrandField intronMotif.
recommendations.root_cause: STAR default outSAMstrandField is None; the Skill assumes tagged BAMs.
recommendations.fix: State the XS requirement beside the regtools command (STAR --outSAMstrandField intronMotif or add XS), and tell the reader that zero clusters means a prerequisite or -m problem. (SQ-04)

recommendations.title: IRFinder command and tool version do not run as written
recommendations.problem: IRFinder FastQ -r REF/ -d out sample.fastq exits 1 (-r is required); the real form is IRFinder -m FastQ. The reference build is undocumented, and IRFinder-S 2.0+ is not what installs (IRFinder 1.3.1; BuildRef is FTP-only, use BuildRefFromSTARRef).
recommendations.root_cause: Command written from memory; version floor not checked.
recommendations.fix: Replace with the working IRFinder -m FastQ form, document reference building, and state which IRFinder release was exercised; label IRFinder-S 2.0 unverified if not obtainable. (SQ-05)

recommendations.title: SUPPA2 TPM header and statsmodels pin not stated
recommendations.problem: A pandas-default TPM header yields no output (psiCalculator: no expression values buffered), and SUPPA 2.4 fails on import with statsmodels 0.15.0; 0.14.6 works.
recommendations.root_cause: Input contract and dependency ceiling are undocumented.
recommendations.fix: Document the header-without-index-name TPM format and pin statsmodels<0.15 in the prerequisites. (SQ-06)

recommendations.title: filter_reliable_events range disagrees with the Skill
recommendations.problem: The script hardcodes mean PSI 0.1-0.9 while the quality table says 0.05-0.95 and claims rMATS/SUPPA2 default filters drop near-constitutive events; rMATS output contains PSI 0 and 1 rows.
recommendations.fix: Expose the bounds as parameters defaulting to the documented range and correct the default-filter claim. (SQ-07)

recommendations.title: IncFormLen description wrong for JC files
recommendations.problem: The Skill says IncFormLen adds exon body bases; JC IncFormLen is 2*(L-1) (98 at L=50) and the body appears only in JCEC (149).
recommendations.fix: State the JC and JCEC lengths separately. (SQ-08)

recommendations.title: MAJIQ V3 and VAST-TOOLS not labeled not-executed; benchmark figures unsourced
recommendations.problem: MAJIQ V3 commands and Zarr claims (restricted licence) and VAST-TOOLS (heavy VASTDB) are presented without an unexecuted/unverified label; figures such as FDR 15-30% and 14% novel-junction loss lack inline evidence.
recommendations.root_cause: Surfaces that cannot be run are written like tested ones.
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line not-executed label for MAJIQ and VAST-TOOLS and mark unsourced figures as literature claims. (SQ-09)

recommendations.title: Related Skills names do not resolve on the shelf
recommendations.problem: differential-splicing and others lack the bio- prefix, and read-alignment/star-alignment and rna-quantification/alignment-free-quant (both required upstream) have no shelf Skill.
recommendations.root_cause: Provider-style paths were kept in normalization.
recommendations.fix: Use shelf IDs where they exist and describe or drop the two missing upstream steps. (SQ-10)

recommendations.title: Input formats and tool provenance not stated
recommendations.problem: rMATS --b1/--b2 list-file format is not described, leafcutter_cluster_regtools.py has no stated source (usage-guide installs only the R package), and there is no Skill-root LICENSE.
recommendations.root_cause: Prerequisites written for a reader who already knows the tools.
recommendations.fix: Describe the comma-separated BAM list, name where the clustering script comes from, and add a LICENSE. (SQ-11)
